title: Preserve truthful native gate provenance and bounded Windows execution
goal: Bind receipts to the observed publication base, retain exact merge-parent and source ancestry checks and legacy verification, and keep native process execution bounded without skipping checks.
checkpoint: Receipt v2 implemented and independently reviewed; ship regressions18/18 and verifier19/19 passed, Clippy passed. Ready for full native combined-tree gate. Commercial cap and PID fixes retained; no proof reuse enabled.
reuse_design: Only exact-candidate/same-attempt completed whole binaries; filters/docs/custom harness/unknown flags run fresh.

Resolve acceptance with successful Cargo no-run JSON; require complete unambiguous artifact inventory and exact features/profile/package ID/target/triple/executable hash plus dependent product and dynamic artifact closure.

Bind final executable args/cwd/effective environment hash, toolchain/sysroot/config/lock/runner digest, clean-home role, immutable per-binary log/counts and unique execution ID. Never persist secret values.
Explicit reused-binary-coverage-v1 variant; only earlier successful executed sources, no forward refs/cycles/reuse-of-reuse; same candidate and attempt. Re-merge invalidates all coverage.

Gate receipt publication must retain reused-versus-executed distinction. Negative tests cover all identity changes, incomplete/duplicate inventories, failed or empty source, changed artifacts/logs, foreign attempt, unsupported selectors.
